title: Engine Dynamometer Test Rig
overview: Engine dynamometer prototype designed to collect engine performance data for future experimental projects, including development of a hybrid-electric go-kart.
scope: Hardware design, material sourcing, structural fabrication, and data collection setup for small engine testing.
materials:
• Structural materials for the rig frame
 • Hardware (fasteners, mounts) to secure the test engine
 • Data-collection components/sensors for measuring engine output
fabricationSteps:
1. Design the dynamometer frame and mounting layout for the target test engine.
 2. Source structural materials and hardware.
 3. Fabricate the frame and mounting points.
 4. Install the load/braking mechanism used to apply resistance to the engine.
 5. Integrate sensors and a data-collection setup to record engine performance metrics.
 6. Mount the test engine to the rig and run initial calibration tests.
 7. Collect and document engine performance data.
outcome: Delivered a functional dynamometer testing rig with media assets and invoice documentation.
